theorem unitRankOneCovariance_momentPackage
    [CompleteSpace E]
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (sample : Omega → E) (population : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hsampleUnit : ∀ omega, ‖sample omega‖ = 1)
    (hRankOneIntegrable :
      Integrable (fun omega =>
        InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℝ (sample omega) (sample omega)) mu)
    (hPopulation :
      ∫ omega, InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℝ (sample omega) (sample omega) ∂mu =
        population) :
    IsSelfAdjoint population ∧
      ‖population‖ ≤ 1 ∧
      (∫ omega,
          (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℝ (sample omega) (sample omega) -
            population) ^ (2 : ℕ) ∂mu =
        population - population ^ (2 : ℕ)) ∧
      ‖population - population ^ (2 : ℕ)‖ ≤ 2 * ‖population‖
approved_definition_context: E is a complete real inner-product space inherited from the surrounding section variables and the theorem binder.
Measure, IsProbabilityMeasure, Integrable, and the displayed integral are Mathlib Bochner-integration notions.
InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℝ x x is the continuous operator y ↦ ⟪x,y⟫x.
IsSelfAdjoint is the adjoint symmetry predicate for a continuous linear endomorphism, and powers use operator composition.
